class="hero-main-title m-0 p-0 text-[32px] font-semibold tracking-normal text-(--Labels-Primary)" style="line-height:48px"><span>Kimi Admin API 开放组织管理能力</span></h1><p class="hero-main-subtitle m-0 p-0 text-[18px] leading-[26px] font-normal text-(--Labels-Secondary)">将 Admin API 接入企业现有系统，自动处理成员入离职、项目与权限管理、财务对账和安全审计。</p></div><div class="hero-block-props"><span class="text-base font-normal leading-6 开放平台 Kimi Admin API 开放组织管理能力" class="block h-auto w-full rounded-xl border-[0.5px] border-(--Separators-S1)"/></figure></div></div><section class="w-full" data-show-log-id="_R_26av5ubqhd9fivb_"><div class="vp-doc vp-raw resources-article"><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-root markdown"><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">当企业内部多个团队都在使用 Kimi API，围绕账号、权限、费用和安全的日常管理负担也会随之增加：员工入职、离职时，管理员需要调整权限、清理密钥；财务需要定期核对账单和用量；安全团队需要核查审计日志，排查异常操作等。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">过去，这些工作都要在控制台手动完成，再将结果同步到企业内部系统。管理人员不仅要在两套系统之间来回切换、重复操作，也容易出现遗漏。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">现在，Kimi 开放平台向企业提供「组织管理接口」 <strong>Admin API</strong>，方便管理员将原本要在控制台手动做的成员、项目、密钥管理以及账单用量查询，接进企业自己的系统自动执行，减少重复操作、<strong>对账更方便、权限和密钥更好管</strong>。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph"><strong>Admin API 接口免费</strong>，调用时不产生额外的计费项。在 <a href="https://platform.kimi.com/" target="_self">platform.kimi.com</a> 注册并完成企业认证后，即可体验。详细的接口定义、参数和返回格式见 <a href="https://platform.kimi.com/docs/admin-api/overview" target="_self">Admin API 参考</a>。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--component kit-weaver-markdown-component--callout kit-weaver-markdown-tier--media"><div class="border-(--Others-LightOrangeBg) bg-(--Others-LightOrangeBg) text-(--Colors-Orange) mt-5 flex items-start gap-[16px] Key，再将其移出组织。</td><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell" rowSpan="1" colSpan="1" style="text-align:left">避免留下可用凭证和权限。</td></tr><tr><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell rowSpan="1" colSpan="1" style="text-align:left">定时将日账单、产品账单和请求明细同步到财务系统。</td><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell" rowSpan="1" colSpan="1" style="text-align:left">减少手工导表，方便核对费用和逐笔 token 用量。</td></tr><tr><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell kit-weaver-markdown-table-first-column-cell" rowSpan="1" colSpan="1" style="text-align:left">成本分摊</td><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell kit-weaver-markdown-table-second-column-cell" rowSpan="1" colSpan="1" style="text-align:left">按项目汇总账单和用量，对应到部门或业务线。</td><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell" rowSpan="1" colSpan="1" style="text-align:left">按团队核算费用和用量。</td></tr><tr><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell kit-weaver-markdown-table-first-column-cell" rowSpan="1" colSpan="1" style="text-align:left">余额监控与充值提醒</td><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell kit-weaver-markdown-table-second-column-cell" rowSpan="1" colSpan="1" style="text-align:left">定时查询账户余额，低于设定阈值时触发提醒或充值审批。</td><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell" rowSpan="1" colSpan="1" style="text-align:left">及时发现余额不足并安排充值。</td></tr><tr><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell kit-weaver-markdown-table-first-column-cell" rowSpan="1" colSpan="1" style="text-align:left">429 错误排查</td><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell kit-weaver-markdown-table-second-column-cell" rowSpan="1" colSpan="1" style="text-align:left">查询组织速率限制，并关联用量数据和业务请求日志排查原因。</td><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell" rowSpan="1" colSpan="1" style="text-align:left">判断是否触发限速，缩小排查范围。</td></tr><tr><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell kit-weaver-markdown-table-first-column-cell" rowSpan="1" colSpan="1" style="text-align:left">安全审计</td><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell kit-weaver-markdown-table-second-column-cell" rowSpan="1" colSpan="1" style="text-align:left">定期获取 Admin Key 信息和审计日志，接入内部审计流程。</td><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell" rowSpan="1" colSpan="1" style="text-align:left">及时发现异常操作和权限变化。</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h2"><h2 id="quickstart" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-2">快速开始</h2></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h3 kit-weaver-markdown-block--subheading"><h3 id="complete-organization-verification" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-3">完成企业认证</h3></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">进入「控制台 → 组织管理 → 组织认证」完成企业认证。认证完成后，Admin API 自动开通，无需单独申请。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h3 kit-weaver-markdown-block--subheading"><h3 id="create-an-admin-api-key-in-the-console" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-3">在控制台创建 Admin Key</h3></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">Admin Key 只能在控制台创建。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">组织管理员进入「控制台 → 组织管理 → Admin API Keys」，创建 Admin Key。创建时，按实际用途选择权限：</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--component kit-weaver-markdown-component--content-table kit-weaver-markdown-tier--media"><div class="vp-doc-table-container kit-weaver-markdown-table-wrap"><div tabindex="0" class="vp-doc-table-wrapper"><table ContentTable-module__WXk9fW__headerCell" rowSpan="1" colSpan="1" style="text-align:left" scope="col">要执行的操作</th><th class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell kit-weaver-markdown-table-second-column-cell ContentTable-module__WXk9fW__firstRowCell ContentTable-module__WXk9fW__headerCell" rowSpan="1" colSpan="1" style="text-align:left" scope="col">需要选择的权限</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell kit-weaver-markdown-table-first-column-cell" rowSpan="1" colSpan="1" style="text-align:left">查看成员、项目和推理 API Key 等信息</td><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell kit-weaver-markdown-table-second-column-cell" rowSpan="1" colSpan="1" style="text-align:left">组织只读（<code>org:read</code>）</td></tr><tr><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell kit-weaver-markdown-table-first-column-cell" rowSpan="1" colSpan="1" style="text-align:left">管理成员、邀请、项目、项目成员和推理 API Key</td><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell kit-weaver-markdown-table-second-column-cell" rowSpan="1" colSpan="1" style="text-align:left">组织读写（<code>org:write</code>，已包含组织只读）</td></tr><tr><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell kit-weaver-markdown-table-first-column-cell" rowSpan="1" colSpan="1" style="text-align:left">查询账单、余额和用量</td><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell kit-weaver-markdown-table-second-column-cell" rowSpan="1" colSpan="1" style="text-align:left">账单只读（<code>billing:read</code>）</td></tr><tr><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell kit-weaver-markdown-table-first-column-cell" rowSpan="1" colSpan="1" style="text-align:left">查询审计日志</td><td class="kit-weaver-markdown-table-cell kit-weaver-markdown-table-second-column-cell" rowSpan="1" colSpan="1" style="text-align:left">审计只读（<code>audit:read</code>）</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">如果同一 Admin Key 需要多项能力，可以同时选择对应权限。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">创建后，立即复制并妥善保存完整密钥。完整密钥只在创建或轮换时显示一次，不要在代码中硬编码或与他人共享。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">在终端中设置后续示例使用的环境变量：</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--code"><div><div class="resources-standard-code-block"><div style="display:contents"><pre class="language-bash"><code class="language-bash"><span class="token builtin class-name">export</span> <span class="token assign-left variable">MOONSHOT_ADMIN_KEY</span><span class="token operator">=</span><span class="token string">&quot;替换为你创建的 Admin Key&quot;</span></code></pre></div><div kit-weaver-markdown-block--h3 kit-weaver-markdown-block--subheading"><h3 id="manage-organization-members" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-3">管理组织成员</h3></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">通过 API 可以 <a href="https://platform.kimi.com/docs/admin-api/invite-create" target="_self">创建邀请</a>、<a href="https://platform.kimi.com/docs/admin-api/invite" target="_self">查询邀请状态</a>、<a href="https://platform.kimi.com/docs/admin-api/members" target="_self">查询组织成员</a>、<a href="https://platform.kimi.com/docs/admin-api/member-update-role" target="_self">修改成员角色</a> 和 <a href="https://platform.kimi.com/docs/admin-api/member-remove" target="_self">移除成员</a>。受邀人接受邀请后，再为其配置项目权限。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">移除成员前，先吊销其名下的推理 API Key。成员被移出组织后，其 Admin Key 会失效，但项目推理 API Key 不会自动吊销。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h3 kit-weaver-markdown-block--subheading"><h3 id="manage-projects-and-budgets" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-3">管理项目与预算</h3></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">通过 API 可以 <a href="https://platform.kimi.com/docs/admin-api/project-create" target="_self">创建</a>、<a href="https://platform.kimi.com/docs/admin-api/project-update" target="_self">修改</a> 和 <a href="https://platform.kimi.com/docs/admin-api/project-archive" target="_self">归档项目</a>，也可以 <a href="https://platform.kimi.com/docs/admin-api/project-spend-limits-update" target="_self">设置项目日消费预算和月消费预算</a>。项目日/月消费预算按 Asia/Shanghai 自然日/月累计。达到已设置且大于 0 的预算后，该项目后续 API 请求会被拒绝；消费统计与限制生效存在延迟，延迟期间产生的费用仍需支付。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">归档项目前，应确认项目中没有仍在运行的业务。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h3 kit-weaver-markdown-block--subheading"><h3 id="manage-project-members" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-3">管理项目成员</h3></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">通过 API 可以 <a href="https://platform.kimi.com/docs/admin-api/project-member-add" target="_self">添加项目成员</a>、<a href="https://platform.kimi.com/docs/admin-api/project-member-update-role" target="_self">调整项目成员角色</a> 和 <a href="https://platform.kimi.com/docs/admin-api/project-member-remove" target="_self">将成员移出项目</a>。只能添加已加入组织的成员。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h3 kit-weaver-markdown-block--subheading"><h3 id="manage-inference-api-keys" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-3">管理推理 API Key</h3></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">通过 API 可以 <a href="https://platform.kimi.com/docs/admin-api/project-api-keys" target="_self">查询</a>、<a href="https://platform.kimi.com/docs/admin-api/api-key-rename" target="_self">改名</a> 和 <a href="https://platform.kimi.com/docs/admin-api/api-key-revoke" target="_self">吊销</a> 已有推理 API Key，但不能创建新 Key。吊销前，应根据 Key 所属项目和成员确认影响范围，避免影响仍在运行的业务。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h2"><h2 id="query-organization-data" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-2">查询组织数据</h2></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h3 kit-weaver-markdown-block--subheading"><h3 id="query-bills-and-request-details" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-3">查询账单与请求明细</h3></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">金额以 <a href="https://platform.kimi.com/docs/admin-api/billing-daily-bills" target="_self">日账单</a> 和 <a href="https://platform.kimi.com/docs/admin-api/billing-product-bills" target="_self">产品账单</a> 为准，适合用于财务对账和按项目分摊成本。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph"><a href="https://platform.kimi.com/docs/admin-api/billing-request-details" target="_self">请求明细</a> 用于查看逐笔 token 用量。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">某一天的日账单、产品账单和请求明细在次日 07:00（UTC+8）起可查。<a href="https://platform.kimi.com/docs/admin-api/billing-interrupted-requests" target="_self">中断请求明细</a> 不受这一时间限制，当天数据随写入即可查询。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h3 kit-weaver-markdown-block--subheading"><h3 id="query-usage-balance-and-organization-rate-limits" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-3">查询用量、余额与组织限速</h3></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><ul class="kit-weaver-markdown-list unordered"><li class="kit-weaver-markdown-list-item"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph"><a href="https://platform.kimi.com/docs/admin-api/usage" target="_self">用量聚合</a>：按分钟、小时或天查询 token 用量和调用次数，适合分析使用趋势和项目用量。</p></li><li class="kit-weaver-markdown-list-item"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph"><a href="https://platform.kimi.com/docs/admin-api/billing-account" target="_self">账户余额</a>：定时查询余额，并在低于企业内部阈值时发送提醒或发起充值审批流程。</p></li><li class="kit-weaver-markdown-list-item"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph"><a href="https://platform.kimi.com/docs/admin-api/rate-limits" target="_self">组织限速</a>：业务请求出现 429 时，先查询组织速率限制，再结合用量数据和业务请求记录，判断是否为限速所致。</p></li></ul></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h3 kit-weaver-markdown-block--subheading"><h3 id="query-audit-logs" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-3">查询审计日志</h3></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph"><a href="https://platform.kimi.com/docs/admin-api/audit-logs" target="_self">审计日志</a> 记录控制台管理操作、登录事件和 Admin API 操作，可用于核查异常登录、权限变更和密钥管理操作。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph">组织管理员需要先在控制台开启审计日志。开启后产生的事件才可查询，开启前的事件不会补记，关闭期间也不记录。</p></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--heading kit-weaver-markdown-block--h2"><h2 id="usage-notes" class="kit-weaver-markdown-heading-2">使用注意事项</h2></div><div class="kit-weaver-markdown-block kit-weaver-markdown-block--prose"><ul class="kit-weaver-markdown-list unordered"><li class="kit-weaver-markdown-list-item"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph"><strong>管理 Admin Key 持有者</strong>：持有者退出组织或被注销后，其 Admin Key 会失效。定期检查持有者和权限，并及时交接相关自动化任务。</p></li><li class="kit-weaver-markdown-list-item"><p class="kit-weaver-markdown-paragraph"><strong>处理 Admin API 限流</strong>：同一组织下的所有 Admin Key 共享各接口的调用限额。调用 Admin API 收到 429 时，应逐步延长重试间隔。新增 Admin Key 不会提高限额。</p></li></ul></div><div font-medium whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Primary)">Admin Key 和推理 API Key 在哪里创建？</h3><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 relative overflow-clip size-4 shrink-0 arrow-icon--open"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="block max-w-none arrow-icon size-full"><path fill-opacity="0.9" fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10.75 8.406a.6.6 0 0 0 0-.847L6.1 2.909a.6.6 0 0 0-.85.849l4.228 4.227-4.229 4.259a.6.6 0 1 0 .852.845z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></div></button></div><div id="qa-answer-qa-1" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid answer-grid--open"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid__content"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex items-center pr-8 pb-4 w-full"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-text flex-1 text-base leading-6 whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Secondary) answer-text--open">两类 Key 都在控制台创建。组织管理员在「控制台 → 组织管理 → Admin API Keys」创建 Admin Key；推理 API Key 在「控制台 → 组织管理 → API Key 管理」创建。Admin API 可以查询、改名和吊销已有推理 API Key，但不能创建推理 API Key。</div></div></div></div></div><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex flex-col overflow-clip border-b-[0.5px] border-(--Separators-S1) "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex isolate relative flex-col items-center w-full overflow-clip shrink-0"><button aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="qa-answer-qa-2" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex justify-between items-center py-4 pr-4 pl-0 w-full text-left cursor-pointer"><h3 class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 text-base leading-6 font-medium whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Primary)">吊销推理 API Key 或归档项目后，会发生什么？</h3><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 relative overflow-clip size-4 shrink-0 arrow-icon--open"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="block max-w-none arrow-icon size-full"><path fill-opacity="0.9" fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10.75 8.406a.6.6 0 0 0 0-.847L6.1 2.909a.6.6 0 0 0-.85.849l4.228 4.227-4.229 4.259a.6.6 0 1 0 .852.845z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></div></button></div><div id="qa-answer-qa-2" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid answer-grid--open"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid__content"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex items-center pr-8 pb-4 w-full"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-text flex-1 text-base leading-6 whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Secondary) answer-text--open">吊销推理 API Key 后立即生效，使用该 Key 的模型调用会被拒绝。项目归档后，该项目下推理 API Key 的模型调用也会被拒绝。自动执行这些操作前，应确认 Key 和项目的影响范围。</div></div></div></div></div><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex flex-col overflow-clip border-b-[0.5px] border-(--Separators-S1) "><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex isolate relative flex-col items-center w-full overflow-clip shrink-0"><button aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="qa-answer-qa-3" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex justify-between items-center py-4 pr-4 pl-0 w-full text-left cursor-pointer"><h3 class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 text-base leading-6 font-medium whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Primary)">账单和请求明细什么时候能查？</h3><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 relative overflow-clip size-4 shrink-0 arrow-icon--open"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="block max-w-none arrow-icon size-full"><path fill-opacity="0.9" fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10.75 8.406a.6.6 0 0 0 0-.847L6.1 2.909a.6.6 0 0 0-.85.849l4.228 4.227-4.229 4.259a.6.6 0 1 0 .852.845z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></div></button></div><div id="qa-answer-qa-3" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid answer-grid--open"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid__content"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex items-center pr-8 pb-4 w-full"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-text flex-1 text-base leading-6 whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Secondary) answer-text--open">某一天的日账单、产品账单和请求明细在次日 07:00（UTC+8）起可查；中断请求明细不受这一时间限制，当天数据随写入即可查询。</div></div></div></div></div><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex flex-col overflow-clip border-b-[0.5px] class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex justify-between items-center py-4 pr-4 pl-0 w-full text-left cursor-pointer"><h3 class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 text-base leading-6 font-medium whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Primary)">怎样用请求 ID 查单笔 token 用量？</h3><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 relative overflow-clip size-4 shrink-0 arrow-icon--open"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="block max-w-none arrow-icon size-full"><path fill-opacity="0.9" fill-rule="evenodd" d="M10.75 8.406a.6.6 0 0 0 0-.847L6.1 2.909a.6.6 0 0 0-.85.849l4.228 4.227-4.229 4.259a.6.6 0 1 0 .852.845z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path></svg></div></button></div><div id="qa-answer-qa-4" class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid answer-grid--open"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-grid__content"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex items-center pr-8 pb-4 w-full"><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 answer-text flex-1 text-base leading-6 whitespace-pre-wrap text-(--Labels-Secondary) answer-text--open">调用推理 API 时，在请求头中传入自己的请求 ID（<code>X-Msh-Client-Request-Id</code>）。按时间范围拉取请求明细后，将返回结果中的 <code>client_request_id</code> 与企业请求日志中的请求 ID 逐笔匹配，即可查看对应请求的 token 用量。<!-- -->
<!-- -->请求明细提供 token 等用量信息，不提供金额；金额以日账单、产品账单为准。请求明细和中断请求明细保留 90 天，单次查询的时间范围最多 31 天。</div></div></div></div></div><div class="jsx-124eee1a2e69fd93 flex flex-col overflow-clip border-b-[0.5px]
